---
title: "Validate variant items before a payment starts"
description: "Drop when the pinned release validates variant items in the initiate endpoint and checks that each variant belongs to its item's product."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.2. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

A customer can pay one product's price for another. The cart's subtotal
uses the price of each item's variant, and initiate never checks variant
items: the variant branch sits inside the branch for items without a
variant, so it can't run. A guest cart that pairs an expensive product with
a cheap variant of another product, or that buys a product with variants
enabled at the product's own price, reaches the payment adapter and is
charged that subtotal. Variant stock and missing variant prices go unchecked
too.

Initiate now loads each item's product and, when the item has a variant, the
variant. It refuses a variant that belongs to another product and a product
with variants enabled that has no variant, then runs the products validation
with both, which checks the variant's price and stock.

- **Patch:** `ecommerce-initiate-variant-validation`, committed as `fix(plugin-ecommerce): validate variant items before a payment starts`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit packages/plugin-ecommerce/src/endpoints/initiatePayment.spec.ts; e2e suite (tests/checkout.spec.ts, the tests that refuse a tampered variant cart)`
